tagline: Fast, reliable web access for your AI agents and n8n
maker_comment_excerpt: Hi everyone 👋 It's Daniel, cofounder and CEO of Reduck AI. We've all experienced it: agents can be slow and hallucinate when using a browser. They have to learn sites from scratch, and they browse manually, one click at a time, burning many tokens. That's why we built Reduck MCP 🚀 Agents can now learn how a site works once, and store that knowledge as a deterministic script.
